payout_quote: The Education Plus Plan for individual students is a free Plus Plan for a one-member workspace. It's available for students signed in with their education institution's email per the WHED. Offer terms and conditions apply.
timing: Free Plus applied after verifying the institution-issued email; active while eligibility and school email remain valid.
eligibility: Student or educator at an accredited college/university recognized in the World Higher Education Database; must use the institution-issued email (school email only — student IDs or other documents not accepted); workspace must be on the Free plan with one member; K-12 not eligible for the individual offer.
catches: Free software plan, not cash — saves the Plus subscription cost (~$10-12/month value) but never pays you.
One-member workspace only; not a team license.
School email from a WHED-listed institution is mandatory — student IDs and non-listed schools do not qualify.
K-12 students and educators are not eligible for the individual Education Plus offer.
steps: Sign up for Notion at https://www.notion.com/product/notion-for-education using your institution-issued school email.
Make sure your workspace is on the Free plan and contains only one member.
Go to Settings & Members, then Plans, and click 'Get the Education Plan'.
Verify your school email when prompted.
Your one-member workspace is upgraded to Plus for free while your eligibility and school email remain valid.
biggest_catch: Free Plus plan (~$10/month value), not money — and it only works with a school email from a WHED-listed college/university.
notes: Verified on official Notion page. Route's $10 figure approximates the Plus plan's monthly value; frame as subscription-cost saving, never income.
